prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in until after pet adoption was effective and slightly outperformed predictions (+13.3% measured vs +12.0% predicted), but moving sign-in to onboarding hand-off showed no clear effect.
Home page redesigns like interactive waiting rooms were helpful (+5.6% measured), though predictions were too high (+8.0% predicted).
Adoption incentives like photo quality guides and companion previews were helpful (+7.6% measured), but were overestimated (+10.0% predicted).
Simplifying onboarding path selection copy showed no clear effect.
Adding live 3D render hatching progress trackers to the home page showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: +7.6% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +7.7% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post-Adoption Desktop Readiness Checklist Screen: Add a new screen right before finishing onboarding that displays a desktop readiness checklist and interactive pet launcher. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% (mean 5815s) and 3 support emails reported pets not showing on the desktop or failing to open.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Waiting Room: Reorder sign-in to take place immediately after the waiting screen, allowing pet generation to complete fully before asking for credentials. (why: 8 emails noted pets missing or reset after signing in again, and waiting screen median is 201s. Moving sign-in right after waiting ensures the generated asset state is bound to the new account.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Command Preview Flow: Introduce a spotlight preview flow on home_intro demonstrating how to summon, minimize, and talk to your pet on desktop. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Room Generation Stage Indicator: Show detailed stage-by-stage status text and time estimates on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: The waiting screen (home target step) has a mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), causing users to wander off or abandon setup.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Clarity Headline Update: Update headline and helper body text on choose_path to clarify pre-made vs custom photo adoption routes. (why: Choose path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between custom photo generation and standard pet selection.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Recovery Hint: Display a clear persistence hint below sign-in options explaining how logging in restores previous pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [home, notification] Waiting Completion Desktop Sound Notification: Add an audio alert component and ready notification toggle to the waiting screen when generation finishes. (why: Waiting screen mean time is 2336 seconds (38 minutes); users switch apps and miss when their pet is ready.)
7: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Compact Grid Layout: Change pick_friend screen layout to compact mode with visual choice cards for faster comparison. (why: Adoption stage takes a median 89s / mean 1017s with 63% conversion; standard listing requires too much scrolling.)

scores.note: Addresses major finish step drop (64.8%) backed by support emails, but requires building a new screen.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails; sign-in reordering shows mixed but positive past test results (+7.7%).
Directly targets high-drop finish step and support complaints about desktop controls, but costs high dev effort.
Low confidence since previous waiting screen render/progress trackers had minimal effect (+1.7%).
Very cheap config change, but earlier test of choose_path copy showed no clear effect (+0.1%).
Config-only hint change backed by 8 support emails regarding pet state persistence.
Addresses the long mean wait time (2336s) by notifying users when rendering completes.
Targets the largest funnel leak (adoption 63% conv, 1017s mean time) where adoption tweaks previously saw +7.6% lift.
